statement: Complete the world 3 story quest first because it unlocks key world 3 mechanics
World 3 has three skills to tackle: worship trapping and construction
Buy first skull in World 3 store and upgrade it at Anvil to start gaining worship charge
Souls from worship are needed for practically everything from crafting to upgrades
Wizards are best at worship due to Charge Siphon which steals charge from all other characters for use on the wizard
Using charge siphon only gives XP to your wizard
Each soul is located at a shrine totem; Forest Outskirts totem gives four souls and souls rise with skill efficiency and highest wave
Tower defense activates at any totem with its own stage; reaching higher max wave increases souls given per totem
Early game focus on Boulder Roller Party Starters Frozen Balloon and Storm Collars when unlocked as essential to level
Playing Hunter in tower defense is super OP due to kick ability and rootability
Trapping is huge for progression; trap boxes bought at world 3 shop and better ones crafted at Anvil
Go to the critter location and place a trap equipped in your tools then set a timer per character
Use Hunter ability Eagle Eye to collect and replace all traps on that character instead of manual collection
Manually collecting traps is the worst; just use Eagle Eye despite XP deficit from critters
Trapping gets better with trapping drone from construction and vials
He has a trapping guide for further explanation which he strongly suggests
Squire is the construction class; three areas are building zone cog board and refinery
Refinery is left of the wind table; have materials in storage and turn off to on to start making salts
A refinery cycle is usually 15 minutes and later an hour and can be changed with the node
Never stop printing red salts; always upgrade red salts to highest rank possible and start ASAP
Cog board second tab lets you craft cogs and add them to board to increase build rate flaggy rate and XP
Flaggy rate unlocks new cogs with the pink flags and XP increases XP gained
Each character has a base build rate which gets higher with level; drag and drop cogs and players onto the board
Open the Cog top middle left and drag a character in to construct a cog then hit claim
Rule of thumb always prioritize XP cogs; check via the i at the top
The build tab is where you get insane buildings
Main quest gives two star talents printer sampling and shrine architect; have at least one point in each and add to hotbar
Shrine architect lets you place shrines on any map to give buffs based on what you place
Shrines level only while staying on the same map for a set number of hours and reset when moved
Shrines are at the bottom of the building list and should be unlocked as soon as possible
Middle line has tower defense towers to unlock more towers and upgrade them to cost less and do more damage
3D printer uses sampling star talent to print any skilling or monster material
Printer prints sampled amount every hour; example green spores give spore caps
Leveling printer increases number of players that can use it
Library books talents to higher max cap: baseline 100 up to 125 or as high as 160
Death Note introduces multi-kill: need 100 percent accuracy and 1.5 times max damage of monster; upgrading increases base multi-kill
He has a massive multi-kill guide
Salt Lick has its own upgrades from 3D printer sample size to bigger damage
Storage building gives more storage
Cost cruncher reduces amount needed for building upgrades; super handy
Trapper drone is later game all-in-one trapping interface from placing to collecting and scales off Eagle Eye
Automation arm unlocks another perk with each build; quality of life so get it as soon as possible
Automation arm gives easy automation totem which gains souls from any place with wave of 10 or higher
Prayers give a buff and a curse; unlocked from tower defense and upgraded with souls; equip at own discretion
Keep leveling bubbles especially Shacker C? and FMJ; 30 to 50 is a good mark
Also focus on six other bubbles: bubble nine in orange green and purple cauldron increasing total damage percent
Bubble number five gives base damage based on MP HP and movement speed to help pushing
Make sure to get multi-kill stamps and keep leveling them
Keep leveling post office if you can
Craft bucket of slush at third Anvil tab; recipe drops from various World 3 mobs
Go to Blokes Refrigeration Station and drop bucket on snow pile to summon the boss Dilapidated Slush for candies keys etc
Be careful as these are really strong monsters
Merit shop priority: mob respawn one then telekinetic storage talent (assign to hotbar) then max books food and build slots salt cost
Cheese armor is hard to craft but gives lots of total damage percent; he prefers not to due to budget
About halfway through world 3 start getting flat to DaVinci armor
Next get chaotic Amarok pendant craftable from chaotic Amarok materials for weapon power or bludgeon
Get Serrated Rex rings or upgrade to tenacity rings for total damage percent
At end of world 3 with party dungeons done and glacial weapons started focus on void armor void weapons cheese scarf then caustic cheese scarf
Then tenacity rings or rings that drop from dedicated ramps
Before world 4 work on card farming getting levels and iron tools for stat stick and carry capacity
Max party dungeon flare bow passive stats
Need bare minimum 1 million damage to push partway through world 4
He has a combat guide to build total damage and base damage percent
To reach World 4 do quests to reach Neptune's enter cheese defeat them get the gem and hand it to the Cardinal
